summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the "Settings" section of an application, specifically under "Reading Settings." The main content and functions on this screen include:

1. **Font Size Selection**: A pop-up window titled "Font Size" allows the user to choose the font size for reading mode. The options available are:
   - Small
   - Normal (currently selected)
   - Large
   - Huge

2. **Restore PRO**: An option to restore the PRO version of the app if the user has already purchased it but it hasn't been activated.

The screen also includes a navigation bar at the top with a back button and the title "Settings." At the bottom, there is an advertisement banner.
